title: The Best Prime Day Soundbars Deals to Instantly Upgrade Your Audio
gist: WIRED's Prime Day soundbar roundup lists discounts up to ~43%, led by the Sonos Beam Gen 2 at $359 (discounted after Sonos launched the Beam Ultra) and the Sonos Arc Ultra at $899, alongside budget TCL, LG, Sony and Amazon Fire TV systems.

insights.claim: Sonos recently launched the Sonos Beam Ultra, which explains why the older Beam (Gen 2) is discounted to $359 from $499.
insights.speaker: John Brandon
insights.so_what: Sonos is refreshing its soundbar lineup, with older SKUs being cleared through retail promotions.
insights.quote: Sonos recently launched the Sonos Beam Ultra, so it's no surprise that this older model is on sale right now.
insights.locator: Sonos recently launched the Sonos Beam Ultra

insights.claim: Many of the best soundbar deals require an Amazon Prime membership, with some close to 40 percent off.
insights.speaker: John Brandon
insights.so_what: Prime-gated pricing is a membership-retention lever for Amazon.
insights.quote: Some are close to 40 percent off, but you'll need an Amazon Prime membership to access many of the best deals.

insights.claim: Multi-speaker surround systems are now cheap: TCL's S65K 5.1 system is $230 (43% off) and LG's S40TR 4.1 system is $200, while Amazon's Fire TV Soundbar sells for $80.
insights.speaker: John Brandon
insights.so_what: Low-end home audio is commoditized; premium brands like Sonos differentiate on Atmos and ease of room calibration.
insights.locator: If you really want the most

insights.claim: Dolby Atmos and HDMI eARC remain the main feature dividers between budget and premium soundbars, with the Sonos Arc Ultra praised for convincing single-unit Atmos and easy room calibration.
insights.speaker: John Brandon
insights.so_what: Feature gating around Atmos/eARC sustains price tiers in the soundbar market.
insights.quote: Like all Sonos speakers, room calibration is remarkably easy compared to other soundbars.
